text: Closed with live JDK22 evidence. Focused scalar/rank/mutable/view suites pass 30/30 on JVM and 30/30 on Scala.js, including offset, reverse, transpose, broadcast, empty, wrong-arity, bounds, and mutable locality cases. Rank-two reads now take 0.687-0.892 ns/access with only 0.000009-0.000012 B/access of normalized profiler noise, a 17.25x-22.03x same-host speedup from the 152 B/access baseline. Mutable writes take 0.359-3.840 ns/access depending on traversal order with profiler-noise allocation. javap shows direct bounds/address bytecode without index arrays; optimized Scala.js inlines direct address calculation and typed-array access with failure-only error construction. Evidence: modules/benchmarks/results/2026-07-27-local-jdk22-scalar/. A nonessential short addInto follow-up did not run because the approval reviewer reported its usage limit; this does not affect the scalar acceptance evidence.
